RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not estimable from the information provided

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Giving a numerical probability would imply knowledge we don’t have.

Your qualifications justify seeking a clear explanation, but publication counts and PhD completion don’t necessarily determine the outcome. Industry experience, teaching assessments, interviews and departmental needs may legitimately matter.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment, and applicable review deadlines. Check whether a completed PhD was essential at appointment or only by the starting date.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based remarks or inconsistent treatment—not merely because of the panel’s composition.
